prompts.residents: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: game NPC sprite atlas for Bond & Bolt. Create one square 3 by 3 sprite sheet with exactly nine distinct friendly fantasy town residents, one fully isolated full-body human per equal grid cell, actual transparent background. Match the supplied painted chibi town keeper reference: warm hand-painted shading, clean fine outlines, large expressive head, tiny boots, three-quarter front view, readable at 85 pixels high. Each entire figure including hat and boots fits inside its own cell with 8 percent clear padding, no contact across cells. Row 1: elderly female druid herbalist with leafy shawl and basket; dark-skinned young male gardener with overalls and watering can; smiling female grove musician with lute. Row 2: female mage librarian with spectacles, purple pointed hat and books; bearded male astronomer in midnight blue robes holding brass astrolabe; young brown-skinned female alchemist with apron and blue potion. Row 3: rugged female hunter with feather cap and bow; broad older male blacksmith with leather apron and hammer; female knight captain with silver armor, blue cape and sheathed sword. Different faces, hair, skin tones, ages, clothes and silhouettes. All standing, feet aligned near bottom of respective cell. No text, labels, grid lines, scenery, checkerboard or colored background. Preserve genuine alpha transparency. Original characters.
prompts.buildings: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: fantasy RPG city building atlas. Make a single landscape sprite sheet, EXACTLY four columns and two rows of eight isolated buildings, in equally sized cells. Transparent background with genuine alpha; no checkerboard, ground plane, text, labels, grid lines or shadows crossing cells. Style matches reference painterly warm storybook RPG scenery, three-quarter elevated frontal view, richly detailed cozy architecture with clearly visible front entrance, readable at 300px wide. Each entire building stays within its own cell with at least 6 percent transparent padding on every side. Column 1 DRUID: top a large ancient living tree guildhall with round lit doorway, carved wooden balcony, leafy canopy and hanging plants; bottom a charming herbalist cottage with moss roof, herb pots and glass greenhouse. Column 2 MAGIC: top a grand purple roofed mage library tower with arched entrance, brass armillary, stained glass stars and rows of lit windows; bottom a blue roofed alchemy shop with luminous glass potion windows, stone stairs and chimney. Column 3 HUNTER: top a large timber hunters lodge with carved stag sign, moss roof, bows and feather banners; bottom a rustic ranger outfitter with leather awning, backpacks, bow racks and crates. Column 4 KNIGHT: top a white stone miniature castle keep with two towers, blue banners, crenellations, golden lion crest and broad arched gate; bottom a stone blacksmith workshop with red tile roof, forge chimney, anvil and armor displayed. No people, no copyrighted logos. Entire roofs and bases visible. Flat orthographic 2.5D asset perspective. Original game buildings.
prompts.buildingBackdropEdit: Background extraction edit ONLY. Remove the gray-and-white checkerboard completely and output TRUE RGBA TRANSPARENCY with alpha 0 around the eight buildings. The checkerboard is unwanted pixels, it is not part of the artwork. Preserve all eight buildings, exact locations, relative scale, entire canvas dimensions, all paint details, all roofs, doors and colors unchanged. Do not draw a new backdrop or checkerboard. Export actual transparent PNG cutouts in the same 4 columns x 2 rows arrangement.
prompts.interiors: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: four fantasy RPG room backgrounds in one square 2 by 2 atlas. Each quadrant is a complete rectangular interior scene viewed from elevated frontal 2.5D perspective, like a cozy hand-painted JRPG, walls at the back and a generous open walkable floor in the lower half, no characters, no text, no UI. HARD exact straight divisions at 50 percent horizontal and vertical. Top left: druid guild treehouse interior with warm timber floors, living trunk pillars, botanical shelves, soft leaf roof, tea table and fern planters. Top right: mage library with purple banners, towering filled bookshelves along back and left walls, brass globe on right, reading lectern near left, star mosaic stone floor. Bottom left: hunters lodge with amber wood floors, trophy carvings, maps on walls (no writing), archery targets to right, bow racks to left, leather packs and a broad table at back. Bottom right: knight keep training hall with blue banners, white stone arches, armor racks to left, two wooden sword practice dummies to right, red and blue carpet and a long stone floor. All four rooms must have empty central floor for game actors and a clear doorway opening at bottom middle. Detailed painterly storybook style, realistic materials but warm stylized proportions, soft ambient lighting, strongly different colors per room. Edge-to-edge scenes; no gutters or white margins. Original fantasy environments.

framing: Residents: equal 3x3 cells. Buildings: four columns, row split at 480/887. Interiors: equal 2x2 cells.
transparency: Generated building and resident source PNGs are RGB with neutral checker backdrops. city-art.js isolates edge-connected neutral pixels at load time; the preserved source PNGs are not native RGBA.
approval: Requested integration; final visual acceptance remains pending.
